Pinned products sort tooltip: Sorts the pinned products list. 'Sorted high/low' and 'low/high' order by total stored amount across all storage (the number on each row). 'Global storage high/low' and 'low/high' order by how full each product's global storage is (the colored bar), fullest first or emptiest first. Items only swap when the difference is at least 5%, so the list doesn't jump around.

This fixes the very old auto-recovery logic that used to loop forever or skip some trucks/excavators that were truly stuck.
